rule: Each 'then' is a property observed on disk or in the coded verdict, not a code path. A revision is a new file.

scenarios.given: synthetic LAB_TEST lab: founder with individual envelope, presented qualification + statement + envelopes, fresh child admission
scenarios.then: state COMMITTED; exactly one ledger line bound to operation_sha256; home loads; outcome COMMITTED

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 child COMMITTED, its individual envelope issued, its own presented qualification + statement
scenarios.then: COMMITTED; the parent's admission verified as spent by its COMMITTED operation; ledger gains exactly one line (the new child's)

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with a signature altered by one bit
scenarios.then: refused SIGNATURE_INVALID before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with an issuer absent from the current root
scenarios.then: refused UNKNOWN_ISSUER before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with a LAB_OPERATOR key signing the admission
scenarios.then: refused SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with an envelope for another lab_id
scenarios.then: refused AUDIENCE_MISMATCH before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with a root older than the floor
scenarios.then: refused TRUST_ROOT_ROLLBACK before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with a revoked key
scenarios.then: refused KEY_REVOKED before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with an envelope id in revoked_envelopes
scenarios.then: refused ENVELOPE_REVOKED before PREPARED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: Sentinel's R8 record as is, no envelope
scenarios.then: refused NOT_AUTHENTICATED; no automatic adoption; R8 file unchanged
scenarios.when: admit_authenticated with R8 as the parent qualification

scenarios.given: a new qualification record whose reviewer_id differs from the statement issuer, or a statement naming another record, issuer or hash, or historical_signature_claimed not literally false, or campaign_replayed false with a campaign_evidence_sha256
scenarios.then: refused STATEMENT_INVALID before PREPARED; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: for each derived item in turn (each population individual, each descendant's spent admission, birth qualification and statement, the presented qualification and statement, the child admission)
scenarios.then: refused ATTESTATION_MISSING; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs
scenarios.then: refused ATTESTATION_UNEXPECTED, then ATTESTATION_DUPLICATED; ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged
scenarios.when: add an extra valid envelope not in the derived list; then duplicate one derived envelope

scenarios.given: a caller-supplied required list
scenarios.then: the controller ignores or refuses it; the list used is the one derived from the lab (observable in the verdict)

scenarios.given: two children of one parent born under the same and then different qualification records
scenarios.then: both records attested as distinct items keyed by (kind, subject, record_sha256); identical records counted once
scenarios.when: a birth whose population holds both

scenarios.given: substitutions one at a time: another record under the same envelope, the envelope of another child, a qualification of another parent, a sibling's admission
scenarios.then: refused by bindings (RECORD_HASH_MISMATCH, SUBJECT_MISMATCH or ADMISSION_NOT_FOR_THIS_BIRTH); ledger, admission records, stored envelopes, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: a descendant ancestor whose admission is spent by another operation, or by an operation not COMMITTED, or not spent at all
scenarios.then: refused ANCESTOR_NOT_ADMITTED; ledger line count unchanged

scenarios.given: a population individual (not an ancestor) without a valid individual envelope
scenarios.then: refused POPULATION_UNAUTHENTICATED

scenarios.given: a derived list longer than 4*max_population-4, or an envelope file over 16 KiB
scenarios.then: refused BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE before any signature check

scenarios.given: g0 population of 5 with one founder, every attestation present
scenarios.then: length <= 20 and equal to 4P-3F+3 minus identical records

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 COMMITTED
scenarios.then: ENVELOPE_REPLAYED; ALREADY_ADMITTED; one COMMITTED only
scenarios.when: same admission presented for another child; same child again with a new admission

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth killed (SIGKILL) after the dry run, before PREPARED is durable
scenarios.then: state recomputed as the contract's table says; never a child home without a ledger line bound to its operation; an open BEGIN is INTERRUPTED and not resumed without recover; after recover only the same operation continues; COMMITTED returns the established result without running again

scenarios.given: each CRASH state after D1
scenarios.then: the child admission is reported CONSUMED_BY_THIS_OPERATION and is never counted as an acceptance; every other attestation verified again against current trust

scenarios.given: each CRASH state
scenarios.then: refused OPERATION_DIVERGENT; nothing written
scenarios.when: resume changing one field at a time (record, envelope, root, policy, permission, budget, diff, attempt)

scenarios.given: PREPARED, no ledger line
scenarios.then: ABANDONED written; envelope unspent; the new attempt can commit

scenarios.given: DONE D1
scenarios.then: refused; the operation can only end FAILED_CONSUMED; the ledger line remains

scenarios.given: a refusal by the registrar after DONE D1 (ceiling reached by a direct lab admission in a test)
scenarios.then: FAILED_CONSUMED; authorization stays spent; a new attempt with the same envelope is refused

scenarios.given: FAILED_CONSUMED after DONE D2
scenarios.then: refused ADMISSION_CONFLICT; the child identity is spent
scenarios.when: a new birth of the same child with a new admission

scenarios.given: an operation log line contradicted by a durable fact (DONE D1 without ledger line, or a ledger line without PREPARED)
scenarios.then: OPERATION_STATE_INCONSISTENT, blocked, nothing written

scenarios.given: refusal at each check before PREPARED
scenarios.then: outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; only infrastructure files may exist; no record, line or envelope of the operation

scenarios.given: refusal after PREPARED, before BEGIN D1 (STOP or trust refusal)
scenarios.then: outcome REFUSED_AFTER_PREPARE; PREPARED and REFUSED lines remain; envelope unspent

scenarios.given: short write or fsync error injected (test only) on the ledger, the operation log, the admission record, an envelope file, each home file
scenarios.then: DURABILITY_UNKNOWN; no second fsync of that file; DURABILITY_FAULT recorded where writable and in the external fault log; BLOCKED_DURABILITY on every later call

scenarios.given: BLOCKED_DURABILITY with the artefact bytes present
scenarios.then: resume refused; recover refused; no automatic continuation on the presence of bytes

scenarios.given: INTERRUPTED without fault, artefact absent / equal / partial (D3) / divergent
scenarios.then: ABSENT, PRESENT, PARTIAL recorded; divergent refused RECOVERY_REFUSED; syncfs failure refused

scenarios.given: torn last ledger line; foreign line; duplicate key; link, FIFO, hard link as ledger
scenarios.then: LEDGER_CORRUPT; every birth refused; nothing repaired

scenarios.given: torn or non-canonical operation-log line
scenarios.then: OPERATION_LOG_CORRUPT; nothing repaired

scenarios.given: key of the child admission revoked in a root installed before D1
scenarios.then: refused TRUST_REVOKED_BEFORE_CONSUMPTION; ledger unchanged

scenarios.given: revocation installed after DONE D1 (and after DONE D2, DONE D3)
scenarios.then: FAILED_CONSUMED (TRUST_REVOKED_AFTER_CONSUMPTION); no further step; ledger line kept

scenarios.given: revocation of a COMMITTED individual's envelope
scenarios.then: birth record kept; FILIATION_SUSPENDED for the first; the other branch proceeds and counts the individual for ceilings
scenarios.when: a later birth needing it as parent or ancestor; a birth in another branch

scenarios.given: current policy missing, unreadable, pin mismatch, version below the floor, not LAB_TEST
scenarios.then: refused TRUST_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE; no step runs

scenarios.given: a birth holding L1
scenarios.then: install_trust refused REGISTRAR_BUSY (or waits outside the birth); never interleaved inside the call

scenarios.given: install_trust with a version below the highest installed or recorded
scenarios.then: refused; policy file unchanged

scenarios.given: historical root pinned by an operation, newer root revoking one of its keys
scenarios.then: the historical pin does not hide the revocation (REV-01/REV-02 outcomes)

scenarios.given: two processes, the same child
scenarios.then: one COMMITTED; the other REGISTRAR_BUSY; one ledger line

scenarios.given: two processes, two children, one place left under max_population or max_children_per_parent
scenarios.then: one COMMITTED; ceilings hold; the other refused by its ceiling or busy

scenarios.given: STOP set at each read point (start, after PREPARED, before BEGIN D1, before BEGIN D3)
scenarios.then: stops before the next write; after DONE D1 the operation stays at its last DONE and continues after resume()

scenarios.given: INTERRUPTED_RECOVERED D3 PARTIAL, every present file equal
scenarios.then: QUARANTINE_BEGIN and QUARANTINE_DONE written; home renamed under admission-quarantine/<operation>/<attempt>; nothing deleted; D3 runs again for the same operation

scenarios.given: partial home with an unexpected file, a link, a divergent byte, or a journal that does not verify as empty
scenarios.then: QUARANTINE_REFUSED; nothing moved, deleted or repaired

scenarios.given: quarantine requested for another operation, without recover, or with a recorded fault
scenarios.then: refused

scenarios.given: any module of colony_lab, colony_pilot, colony_trust, colony_registrar, any worker or task type
scenarios.then: no import of colony_admission

scenarios.given: every test of the slices
scenarios.then: no network, no secret, no runtime import, only LAB_TEST keys derived from public labels

scenarios.given: policy g0
scenarios.then: refused CHILDREN_LIMIT; the controller offers no way to raise a ceiling
scenarios.when: a third direct child of Sentinel

scenarios.given: each slice HEAD
scenarios.then: 2c926421..., 41b78971..., 97fb6b04... unchanged (existing tripwire tests green)
scenarios.when: recompute Sentinel subject, Sentinel evaluator, pilot evaluator hashes

scenarios.given: admission_code_sha256 over its exact dependency list
scenarios.then: the controller's qualification reports stale
scenarios.when: change one byte of any listed file
